question: A 100-mm prick punch with a 7-mm diameter body may have a 2.5-mm diameter point at an angle of _____ to the ground.
solution:
The correct answer is __30°**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prick punch__ is a tool used for marking points on a surface.
 
• It typically has a sharp, pointed tip for precise indentations.
 
• The point angle of the punch is crucial for its effectiveness in marking.
 
• The 30° angle ensures accurate and clean marking without damaging the material.
 
• Such tools are widely utilized in mechanical and engineering applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Punch Tools:**

 
 
• Punch tools are used to create indentations or holes in materials.
 
• They come in various sizes and shapes depending on the application.
 
 
 
• **Marking Techniques:**
 
 
• Marking tools like prick punches are essential in precise manufacturing processes.
 
• The angle and size of the punch tip impact the accuracy of the mark.
 
 
 
• **Applications:**
 
 
• Used in industries such as metalworking, carpentry, and engineering.
 
• Essential for pre-drilling or guiding operations.
